blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in Willoughby

items.t: Suites and coach houses in the Township: a secondary suite can be up to 120 m², one per home, and every suite needs a building permit. A coach house is a home on the second storey of a detached garage, part of the fee-simple lot, never strata.

Short-term rentals and taxes: the Township doesn't issue business licences for short-term rentals (Licencing Bylaw No. 5878). 2026 property taxes were due Thursday, July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty after midnight July 2 and another 5% after midnight September 3; utility fees are billed separately.

faq.q: Is there a named duplex or half-duplex project to shop in Willoughby?
faq.a: Duplexes in Willoughby are individual duplexes on single lots, in a market that's mostly compact-lot detached houses with suites, plus strata condos and townhomes.

faq.q: What lot sizes does the compact-lot zone allow?
faq.a: Compact lot zone (R-CL): lots from 220 m² to 464.5 m², with frontage of 11 m (front-loaded) or 8.2 m (rear-loaded).

faq.q: How big can a suite or coach house be?
faq.a: A secondary suite can be up to 120 m², one per main home, and needs a permit. A coach house is the second storey of a detached garage only, on the same fee-simple title.

faq.q: The plan update — is it law yet?
faq.a: Price future form off the plans actually in force (Bylaw 6200, Schedule 6) until adoption is confirmed.
